text:
PSC::user_name
Description
The PSC::user_name command gets the user name or sets the user name
when the optional is given.
Syntax
PSC
::
user_name
PSC
::
user_name
<
value
>
PSC::user_name
retrieve the user name
PSC::user_name <value>
set the user name
